sourceEvidence.summary: Persistent Chrome verified KJB Meta Ads account 1249689223687250 and published the authorized Philadelphia qualified-lead replacement. The campaign uses Meta Instant Forms, Higher Intent review, restricted sharing, required SMS phone verification, four required qualification questions, and four approved KJB bridal images. The landing-page-view traffic campaign was turned off after the replacement entered Processing.

campaign.type: Lead generation with Meta Instant Forms

budgetBaseline.basis: Existing campaign budget retained during the user-authorized 2026-07-27 live conversion.

requiredAssets: Find Your Gown in Philadelphia headline
copyRequirements: lead with the bridal shopping outcome
set expectation of four qualification questions
avoid unsupported urgency or inventory claims

dailyOptimizationChecks: exact account and campaign delivery readback
qualified-lead campaign review and delivery status
antiRegressionRules: Do not switch the qualified campaign back to Landing Page Views.
Do not remove Higher Intent review, restricted sharing, SMS verification, or the four required qualification questions without current authority.
Do not count tests as leads or appointments.
Do not judge Meta on raw forms alone when appointment outcomes are available.
Do not increase spend until delivery, tracking, and qualified lead quality are reconciled.
Keep Meta and Google campaign evidence distinct.
